Steps 1: DNA Cipher

We start with the letters



From chapter 2 we get

A -> 11C -> 10

Completing that for the other pairing you would get

T -> 00G -> 01

You don't use these values though, you use the inverse because the key isn't this DNA strand by its component.

A -> 00C -> 01T -> 11G -> 10

Decoding this you would get what would appear to be a random string of numbers and letters. This is actually Base64, and upon converting it you would get the following message:

Step 2: Google Collab Neural Network

That links leads you to a google collab. Using it you can download the correct .pth file. Originally I had something where you had to reconstruct the neural network from the .pth file, but none of the people I got to beta test it could figure it out, so I scrapped the idea.
